VBO:0200805.summary: Keen-nosed and strongly interested in game, the hunting Laikas tend to be steady but vigorous workers. East Siberian, West Siberian and Russian-European Laikas are distinct breeds shaped by regional hunting traditions. The wider Laika family also includes the Yakutian, whose traditional work combines pulling sleds with hunting.
VBO:0200805.shortDescription: Steady but vigorous, hunting Laikas pair keen scenting with game interest; the wider family also includes sled workers.

sources.title: FCI305 — East Siberian Laika
sources.evidence: Actual p2–4 allround hunting, regional history, balanced vigorous temperament/keen scent/gamepassion read. Independent hunting and friendlypeople traits East-only, not transferred classwide.

sources.title: FCI306 — West Siberian Laika
sources.evidence: Entire actual standard read: distinct Khanty/Mansi-derived regional hunting breed, steady vigorous keen-scent/game behavior; adult head/eyes/ears/body/four oval feet/harsh coat/grey coloration/55–62cm male and tight curled fulltail overback orhip. No invented hanging tail.
